reference.implementation: Julia 1.13.3, Complex{Rational{BigInt}} and BigFloat (128 to 512 bits), standard library only

conventions.inner product: v^dagger w = sum_j conj(v_j) w_j, antilinear in the first factor (c03.prop.skalarprodukt)

tolerance.note: default; the class of each case is its 'tol', see 'tolerances'

exact.note: sums and products of half-integers are exact in double precision; exact equality

sum.note: partial sums (direct below 65 terms, Euler-Maclaurin beyond), bounds and limits in double precision; unvalidated choice above the measured maximum deviation

erf.note: erf and the Gaussian areas in double precision; unvalidated choice above the measured maximum deviation

eval.note: closed-form evaluation; unvalidated choice above the measured maximum deviation

residual.note: largest modulus of an entry of a product of two 3x3 matrices minus a third, in double precision (B has the inexact entries s/3); unvalidated choice above the measured maximum deviation

eig.note: eigenvalues (shifted QR) and extreme values of <psi|H psi> (Jacobi rotations) in double precision; unvalidated choice above the measured maximum deviation
